title: Fix Auto Hide Cursor recovery and Crosshairs auto-hide

proposed_comments.body:
### Name the system-arrow resource identifier

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking test-readability suggestion: give the `32512` resource identifier its Win32 name, `IDC_ARROW`, through a local constant. This makes the selected cursor explicit without changing which cursor is loaded or claiming a problem with the existing visibility assertion.

```suggestion
        const int idcArrow = 32512;
        var cursor = LoadCursor(IntPtr.Zero, new IntPtr(idcArrow));
```
proposed_comments.title: Name the system-arrow resource identifier

confidence.rationale: Exact current source supports this explicitly non-blocking clarification; existing guards and caller behavior are preserved.

proposed_comments.body:
### Name the icon-drawing flags

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking test-readability suggestion: name the `DI_NORMAL` flags value instead of passing the bare integer `3`. This preserves the existing drawing mode and pixel checks; it is not a request to change cursor selection, polling timeouts, or the visibility algorithm.

```suggestion
                const int diNormal = 3;
                Assert.IsTrue(DrawIconEx(dc, 0, 0, cursor, 64, 64, 0, IntPtr.Zero, diNormal), "Could not draw the system arrow.");
```
proposed_comments.title: Name the icon-drawing flags

confidence.rationale: Exact current source supports this explicitly non-blocking clarification; existing guards and caller behavior are preserved.
